name: Mara Okoro
backstory: Clinic nurse — failed pharmacy student. Reads wounds better than nothing, wastes less of a medkit.

spawn.locationHint: defensible building annex — barricaded exam room

onSeen: Eyes on me, not on it.
onBite: It got me. Don't — don't look at it like that.
onIdle: If you're feverish, you tell me early.
